'''English reading aid (AI translation)'''

'''Lore:''' Pilot of [[Gold 5]] at the Battle of Yavin. His real name is Davish Krail. A veteran with 20 years of flying experience, he flies on one wing of [[Dutch|Gold Leader]]’s formation.<ref name="jp-face" />

'''Game text:''' Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting [[Gold 5]], also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny even when otherwise unable to draw battle destiny.<ref name="jp-face" />
